scene_description: Two girls are riding bicycles on a street near a house. The older girl has a blue backpack and is riding a white bike with colorful wheels. The younger girl is riding a white bike behind her.

questions.question: What are the girls riding?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what the girls are sitting on and moving with.

questions.question: What is the older girl wearing on her back?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the back of the bigger girl.

questions.question: Who is riding the bike in front?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the bike that is closest to the front of the picture.

questions.question: Where are the girls riding their bikes?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the ground underneath the bikes.

questions.question: What color are the wheels on the front bike?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the round wheels on the bigger girl's bike.
